page_title: KOL 0-2 DAR | FC Koln v Darmstadt 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' CHANCE! Sargis Adamyan finds Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
90+5' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
90+3' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' 0 - 2 Gerrit Holtmann fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) inside the box and he sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 0:2.
90' Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Matthias Jollenbeck didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' What a save from Marcel Schuhen! Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
86' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the left post. What a poor effort.
86' Mark Uth (1. FC Koln) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
82' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Tobias Kempe will be replaced by Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt).
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Fabian Nurnberger as he is replaced by Emir Karic (Darmstadt).
81' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
81' Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
80' Here is a change. Jacob Christensen is going off and Timo Schultz gives the last tactical orders to Mark Uth (1. FC Koln).
77' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way wide of the right-hand post.
75' The attendance is 50000.
74' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Marcel Schuhen easily makes the save.
74' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
70' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the right post.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Florian Kainz will be replaced by Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln).
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luca Waldschmidt walks off the pitch to be replaced by Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln).
66' Timo Schultz has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln) replacing Eric Martel.
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) for Tim Skarke.
66' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) offside.
64' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) plants his close-range header just wide of the left post after a cross into the box.
60' The game is interrupted as Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) is flagged offside.
57' 0 - 1 Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) uses his strength and awareness to get the better of the defender and coolly scores from the resulting corner kick.
56' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) prepares to take a corner kick.
56' The resulting corner from Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is cleared by the defence. Darmstadt will take a corner kick.
54' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) produces a cross from the resulting free kick from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper smothers the ball.
53' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Matej Maglica (Darmstadt). Matthias Jollenbeck saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. FC Koln have a free kick from a promising distance.
52' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) is caught offside once again.
51' Chance! Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
49' Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) beats his man to the lofted pass, but his header sails harmlessly well wide of the right post from close range.

46' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Marvin Schwabe is alert and denies him with a nice save.
46' Timo Schultz has made a change at the break. Linton Maina has come on in place of Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Torsten Lieberknecht gives a chance to Mathias Honsak and Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' Matthias Jollenbeck has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jacob Christensen slides a brilliant pass into Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
44' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
43' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) is substituted due to injury. Torsten Lieberknecht gives a chance to Jannik Muller.
41' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Darmstadt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

36' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
34' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
33' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:1. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:0.
30' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
30' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
27' The free kick is delivered by Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
27' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle after Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. FC Koln have a free kick.

24' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Marcel Schuhen, who pulls off a stunning save!
23' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.

18' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
18' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
15' FC Koln couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Marcel Schuhen (Darmstadt) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
14' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) commits a rough challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul. FC Koln have a free kick.
12' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
12' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

12' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. FC Koln force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
11' Matthias Jollenbeck blows the whistle, Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is penalised for a foul. FC Koln will take a free kick.
9' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
8' A rebound sits up nicely for Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
6' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
5' Jeff Chabot (1. FC Koln) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Darmstadt are awarded a free kick.
4' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
3' The game is interrupted now, Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
2' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle and signals a foul after Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) brought his opponent down.
1' The first half has started.
FC Koln will kick the game off.
Matthias Jollenbeck will referee today's match.
